slices.title: Catalog, rank defaults, and the pure can() helper
slices.intent: The fixed permission catalog, the rank-derived default statements, and the pure can() function in lib/auth/permissions.ts. The module stays client-safe: it imports nothing from Node and nothing from the database.

symbols.name: PERMISSION_CATALOG
symbols.expectation: The fixed, exhaustive permission vocabulary. Shape: eleven catalog entries verified against the capability matrix.

symbols.name: defaultPermissionsForRank
symbols.expectation: The rank-derived default statement set per the capability matrix.

symbols.name: can

postcondition.signature:
(
  principal: Principal | null,
  permission: Permission,
  overrides?: ReadonlyMap<Permission, boolean>,
): boolean

symbols.expectation: Pure: rank defaults plus override booleans, no I/O. False for anonymous, true for matrix cells.

symbols.name: ensureAuthSchema
symbols.expectation: Modified: composes role_permissions into the ensure chain beside the six tables.

symbols.name: resolvePermissionSet
symbols.expectation: Merges rank defaults with role_permissions rows. Granted true adds, granted false removes. Caches per request.
